items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Budd Johnson had switched from tenor to alto, and he was playing the head in the band the night I saw him.

ctx.x: Do you have any recollection of that?

No, I don’t have any recollection of that. Because the night I went down there, he was so high, he couldn’t play the lead. Budd Johnson had switched from tenor to alto, and he was playing the head in the band the night I saw him.
Was Gene Ammons in Eckstine’s band then?
